kept_verbatim: all annotation columns (difficulty, stage, grade_level, question_type, statuses)
source and page references as opaque tokens
curriculum_nodes.name and textbooks.name (public textbook catalogue labels)

notes.why_curriculum_labels_are_kept: curriculum_nodes.name and textbooks.name hold textbook volume and chapter titles (for example a chapter heading like '第二章 不等式与不等式组'), i.e. public curriculum structure, not exam content. They are the backbone of the annotation system and are kept deliberately.
notes.why_26_chapter_titles_also_appear_in_sou: A chapter title naturally recurs in the papers belonging to that chapter. The overlap is with the removed source text, not with question stems, and reveals no question content.
notes.why_content_change_ledger_rows_are_dropp: 240,278 rows of before/after state snapshots; every cell in them is a duplicate copy of text that is removed elsewhere. The table itself is kept so the ledger contract still exists in the schema.
notes.question_text_markers: Columns that held question text are filled with the literal string <text-removed> so it is visible where licensed content must be supplied.
notes.shape_stubbing: JSON columns that mix structure with text keep their keys and non-string values; every string value becomes an empty string.
notes.path_de_identification: Distinct source-document paths became <source>/item-0001.docx. Numbering is consistent across tables, so lineage joins still work while filenames are not disclosed.
notes.packing: The database is 187.7 MB unpacked and ships gzip-compressed at 50.6 MB, because GitHub rejects any single file above 100 MB. tools/materialize_sample_bank.py unpacks it.

verification.method: every text cell of the packed artifact was decompressed and scanned for vendor identifiers, Windows absolute paths, and Chinese runs of 12+ characters; each run was then looked up in the private source content to see whether it was removed third-party text
verification.explanation_of_the_26: textbook chapter titles that also occur inside the removed source text, because the papers belong to those chapters. They are catalogue labels, not question content.
verification.baseline_bank: p1-2f_baseline_stripped.db.gz: 0.5 MB packed, 7,330 rows, 65 tables, same scan clean
